result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid problem: energy-type quadratic expressions in p, q, r and auxiliary variables, a function G with Hamilton-type equations for g, h, k, and algebraic evaluation of ratios like k/r in terms of the semi-axes a, b, c.
result.transcription:
$p^2(\lambda^2+\frac{1}{\lambda^2})+q^2(\mu^2+\frac{1}{\mu^2})+r^2(\nu^2+\frac{1}{\nu^2}) = 2\varepsilon H - \frac{1}{2}((\frac{\partial a}{\partial t})^2 [-+\frac{1}{2}-] (\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2+(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t})^2) + const = Q$
$p^2([-(b-c)-]\lambda+(b+c)\frac{1}{\lambda})^2+q^2((c-a)\mu+\frac{c+a}{\mu})^2+r^2([-(a-b)-]\nu+\frac{a+b}{\nu})^2 = \omega^2$
$= \omega_1^2$
$(b-c)^2 u = p\lambda \quad (b+c)^2 u' = p\frac{1}{\lambda}$
$\frac{vw}{u} = \frac{\mu\nu}{\lambda}\frac{(b-c)^2}{(a-c)^2(a-b)^2}$
[-$(c-a)$-]
$+\frac{b+c-2a}{b-c}\frac{vw}{u}+\frac{b+c+2a}{b-c}\frac{v'w'}{u}$
$+\frac{b-c+2a}{b+c}\frac{vw'}{u'}+\frac{b-c-2a}{(b+c)}\frac{v'w}{u'}$
$\frac{(b+c-2a)(c-b)}{(a-c)^2(a-b)^2}\frac{\mu\nu}{\lambda}+\frac{(b+c+2a)(c-b)}{(a+c)^2(a+b)^2}\frac{1}{\lambda\mu\nu}+\frac{(b-c+2a)(b+c)}{(a-c)^2(a+b)^2}\frac{\mu\lambda}{\nu}+\frac{(b-c-2a)(b+c)}{(a-b)^2(a-c)^2}\frac{\nu\lambda}{\mu}$
$\frac{1}{4}\frac{(g+g_1)^2}{(b-c)^2}+\frac{(h+h_1)^2}{(c-a)^2}+\frac{(k+k_1)^2}{(a-b)^2}$
$(\frac{g-g_1}{b+c})^2+(\frac{h-h_1}{c+a})^2+(\frac{k-k_1}{a+b})^2-2\varepsilon H = G$
$\frac{\partial G}{\partial g} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{g+g_1}{(b-c)^2}+\frac{g-g_1}{(b+c)^2} = u+u' = p \qquad g^2+h^2+k^2=\omega^2$
$\frac{\partial G}{\partial g_1} = p_1 \qquad g_1^2+h_1^2+k_1^2=\omega_1^2$
$\frac{\partial g}{\partial t} = rh-qk = \frac{\partial G}{\partial k}h-\frac{\partial G}{\partial h}k$
$\frac{\partial h}{\partial t} = -rg+pk = -\frac{\partial G}{\partial k}g+\frac{\partial G}{\partial g}k$
$\frac{\partial k}{\partial t} = qg-ph = \frac{\partial G}{\partial h}g-\frac{\partial G}{\partial g}h$
$\frac{1}{2}((\frac{\partial a}{\partial t})^2+(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2+(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t})^2)+G = const.$
$\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial G}{\partial a}, \frac{\partial^2 b}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial G}{\partial b}, \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial G}{\partial c}$
$2G = pg+qh+rk+p_1g_1+q_1h_1+r_1k_1-2\varepsilon H$
$\frac{k}{r} = \frac{(a-b)^2\sqrt{(2a+b+c)(2a+b-c)}+(a+b)^2\sqrt{(2a-b-c)(2a-b+c)}}{\sqrt{\phantom{x}}+\sqrt{\phantom{x}}} = \frac{1}{2}((c^2+b^2-2a^2)+\sqrt{4a^2(b+c)^2(4a^2-(b-c)^2)})$
$\frac{k}{r} = \frac{(a-b)^2w+(a+b)^2w'}{w+w'} = \frac{(a-b)^2w^2-(a+b)^2w'^2+4ab\,ww'}{w^2-w'^2}$
$\frac{w^2}{\varsigma} = (2a+b)^2-c^2 \quad \frac{1}{\varsigma}(w^2-w'^2) = 8ab$
$\frac{w'^2}{\varsigma} = (2a-b)^2-c^2 \quad \frac{1}{\varsigma}((a-b)^2w^2-(a+b)^2w'^2) = \frac{1}{\varsigma}((2a^2-ab-b^2)^2-(2a^2+ab-b^2)^2) = -4ab(2a^2-b^2)+4abc^2$
$4a^4-4a^2(b^2+c^2)+(b^2+c^2)^2$
$16a^4-4a^2(b^2+c^2)+(b^2-c^2)^2$
$\frac{r}{k} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{(c^2+b^2-2a^2)-\sqrt{\phantom{x}}}{[-a^2c^2+b^2c^2-\ldots-]-3a^4}$
$-12a^4+4a^2(b^2+c^2)+4b^2c^2$
$G = \frac{\omega^2}{c^2+b^2-2a^2+\sqrt{\phantom{x}}}+\frac{\omega_1^2}{c^2+b^2-2a^2-\sqrt{(b+c)^2-4a^2(b-c)^2-4a^2}}-2\varepsilon H$
$c^2 = a^2\frac{3a^2-b^2}{a^2+b^2} \qquad b^2 = a^2\frac{3a^2-c^2}{a^2+c^2}$
$(w+w')((a-c)^2v+(a+c)^2v') [-(v+v')-] (a-b)^2w+(a+b)^2w'$
$b^2$
$(b-a)^2-(c-a)^2vw+((b+a)^2-(c+a)^2)v'w'+((b+a)^2-(c-a)^2)vw'+(b-a)^2-(c+a)^2v'w$
$(v+v')(b-a)^2w+(b+a)^2w'-$
$b-c \quad (b+c-2a)vw+$
$(a-c)^2((2a+c)^2-b^2)+(a+c)^2(2a-c)^2-b^2$
$2a^2-ac+c^2$
$(2(2a^2-c^2)^2+2a^2c^2-2b^2(a^2+c^2))\cdot\varphi+2a^2((2a^2-b^2)^2+2a^2b^2-2c^2(a^2+b^2))$
$\frac{4a^4}{c^2} [-+2-] -3a^2+c^2-b^2-\frac{b^2a^2}{c^2}$
$(4a^4\frac{b^2+c^2}{b^2c^2}-6a^2+[-\ldots-]-\frac{b^4+c^4}{b^2c^2}a^2)(c^2\varphi+b^2\varsigma)$
$(b^2-c^2)(\frac{4a^4}{b^2c^2} [-+2a^2-] -2-\frac{b^2+c^2a^2}{b^2c^2})c^2\varphi-b^2\varsigma$
